_methodology: MONOTONIC FUNNEL (rank roll-up) with OA/EVERGREEN/POOLING/EXCLUDE_HASHES exclusions applied. Stage ranks: Initial Interview=1, Client Endorsement=2, Client Interview=3, Job Offer=4, Offer Accepted/Ongoing Contract=5, Started=6, Failed=0. A match at rank K emits one dated event for every rank R<=K (it must have passed through them), dated by: rank1 interview_at, rank2 submitted_at, rank3 interview_at, rank4 offer_at, rank5 hired_at, rank6 updated_at - each falling back to updated_at when null. Events are pooled per CANDIDATE. For month M and rank R, a candidate is counted if they have any event in M at rank >= R, which makes Interviews>=Endorsed>=ClientPass>=Offers>=Hires>=Starts true by construction. YTD totals are unique candidates by max rank reached, so YTD is NOT the sum of the months. EXCLUSIONS: (a) Outsource Accelerator internal orgs 599280 and 1619851; (b) EVERGREEN REQUISITION org 1560151; (c) any job whose position_name contains 'POOLING'; (d) 10 EXCLUDE_HASHES per manatal/constants.py. Position type is derived from Manatal custom_fields.justification: 'NEW LOGO' and 'NEW REQUIREMENT' both map to New Logo (both labels are treated as one bucket - Manatal's dropdown was renamed and legacy jobs still carry the old label); 'RAMP' -> Ramp; 'BACKFILL' -> Backfill; any other value is Unclassified and excluded from positionTypes[] conversions. A candidate active on jobs of multiple types is counted in EACH type.

_schema.monthly[]: Per-month funnel counts (interviews/endorsed/clientPass/offers/hires/starts), conversion percentages, TTF and role-flow fields from that month's snapshot.
_schema.ytdTotals: Unique candidates reaching each rank across the full period.
_schema.overallConversion: YTD conversion percentages computed from ytdTotals.
_schema.kpiSnapshot: KPI vs target keyed by metric, each {actual, target, status, note?}. Status: green = at/above target, yellow = within 10 points below, red = further below, gray = no target or no data.
_schema.positionTypes[]: New Logo / Ramp / Backfill roles filled, avg & median TTF, currently-open counts, and per-type candidate funnel conversions (intToEnd/endToClientPass/endToHire/intToHire/offerToStart). Position type comes from Manatal custom_fields.justification (NEW LOGO + NEW REQUIREMENT -> New Logo, RAMP -> Ramp, BACKFILL -> Backfill). A candidate active on jobs of multiple types is counted in each type. _funnel exposes the raw unique-candidate counts behind each conversion.
_schema.agingBuckets: Currently-open HEADCOUNT by days open (d0_30/d31_45/d46_60/d61_90/gt90), recomputed from the current month's aging.jobs.
_schema.oldestOpen[]: Top 10 oldest currently-open roles, oldest first by days open.
_schema.insights: Derived narrative: best/weakest month, TTF trend, longest-TTF position type, biggest bottleneck and recommended action.
_schema.dataGaps[]: Known holes in the underlying data.

_dataQuality.note: Loaded 1583 match records; applied filter dropping 298 OA-internal + 0 EVERGREEN + 0 POOLING + 40 EXCLUDE_HASHES = 338 total; kept 1245 candidate-job matches across 1207 unique candidates. NEW LOGO and NEW REQUIREMENT both bucket to 'New Logo' (Manatal dropdown value + legacy value). 17 candidates are Unclassified (their jobs' justification is neither NEW LOGO/NEW REQUIREMENT nor RAMP nor BACKFILL) and are excluded from per-type conversions but counted in overall YTD.

insights.longestTtfPositionType: New Logo - 54.0d average time-to-fill (n=27), vs Backfill at 36.2d. New Logo roles take materially longer to close.

insights.biggestBottleneck: Endorse -> Hire at 24.3% vs a 50% target - 25.7 points short, the widest gap of any tracked conversion.
insights.recommendedAction: Attack Endorse -> Hire first - it is 25.7 points below its 50% target and gates every downstream stage.

Regularization rate is not tracked in Manatal - kpiSnapshot.regularization.actual is null.

Manatal's Open API exposes only each match's CURRENT stage, so a candidate endorsed and then failed on a job collapses to rank 0 on that job; they still count if another of their matches holds rank >= 2.
Sep 2026 has TTF data for 7 of 8 closed-won roles; 1 role(s) have no start date yet and are excluded from TTF.
YTD totals are unique-candidate counts and deliberately do not equal the sum of the monthly columns.
